column1: # GE-T10's questions (SMYSL-2.5 §5.5; TX-P8 step 4): thirty, each asked in the five tier-1
# languages, a hundred and fifty rows.
# Written by the same hand as corpus.smy and slots.tsv, and written as a person would ask them
# rather than as the intent table spells them. Where that person inflects the subject — Russian
# above all, where "what depends on miasma" puts it in the genitive — the question keeps the
# inflection, and the harness counts the subject it then fails to find (PLANT morph). Nothing
# was rephrased after a run to make a question resolve.
#   qid       the question, the same in every language; slots.tsv is keyed by it
#   intent    the intent the question asks, which the classifier is scored against
#   lang      the language of the question
